units.source_text: 匂皇子正从明石皇后的上房中退出，将回到自己的值宿所去。

en.t: Prince Niou was just leaving Empress Akashi's upper apartments and was about to return to his own night-duty quarters.

units.source_text: 许多殿上人送他出来，小公子也挤在里头。

en.t: Many courtiers came out to see him off, and the young lord was crowded among them too.

units.source_text: 匂皇子看见了他，问道：“昨天你为什么早就退出了？

en.t: Prince Niou noticed him and asked, "Why did you leave so early yesterday?

units.source_text: 今天什么时候进来的？”

en.t: When did you come in today?"

units.source_text: 小公子答道：“昨天我退出太早，后来懊悔。

en.t: The young lord answered, "Yesterday I left too early, and afterward I regretted it.

units.source_text: 今天听说您还在宫中，我就赶紧来了。”

en.t: Today I heard that you were still in the palace, so I hurried here."

units.source_text: 这童声非常亲切悦耳。

en.t: The child's voice was very warm and pleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 匂皇子说：“不但宫中，我那二条院里很好玩，你也常常来吧。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "It is not only the palace; my Nijo residence is very amusing too, so you should come often.

units.source_text: 有许多小伴聚集在那里呢。”

en.t: Many young companions gather there."

units.source_text: 别的人看见匂皇子专对他一人说话，大家都不走近去，随即各自散开了。

en.t: When the others saw that Prince Niou was speaking only to him, they did not come closer and soon dispersed one by one.

units.source_text: 此时四周很清静，匂皇子又对小公子说：“近来皇太子不大召唤你了。

en.t: Now that the surroundings were quiet, Prince Niou said again to the young lord, "The Crown Prince has not been summoning you much lately.

units.source_text: 以前不是常常叫你进去的么？你大姐夺了你的宠爱，不像话吧。”

en.t: Did he not often call you in before? Your elder sister has stolen your favor; that is rather outrageous, is it not?"

units.source_text: 小公子答道：“不断地叫我进去，我苦死了。

en.t: The young lord answered, "Being called in constantly was terribly hard for me.

units.source_text: 倘是到您这里来……”他不再说下去。

en.t: If it were to come to your place..." He said no more.

units.source_text: 匂皇子说：“你姐姐看我不起，不把我放在心上。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "Your sister looks down on me and gives me no place in her heart.

units.source_text: 这原是理所当然的，但教我难于忍受。

en.t: That may be only natural, but it is hard for me to bear.

units.source_text: 你家东厅那位姐姐，自昔和我同是皇族。

en.t: The sister in the east wing of your house has, from the past, belonged to the same imperial blood as I do.

units.source_text: 你替我悄悄地问问她：她是不是爱我？”

en.t: Ask her quietly for me whether she loves me."

units.source_text: 小公子看见机会到了，便把那枝红梅和诗呈上。

en.t: Seeing that his chance had come, the young lord presented the branch of red plum and the poem.

units.source_text: 匂皇子笑着想道：“倘是我求爱之后收到的答诗，就更好了。”

en.t: Prince Niou smiled and thought, "It would be even better if this were a reply poem received after I had courted her."

units.source_text: 便反复观玩，不忍释手。

en.t: He looked it over again and again, admiring it, and could not bear to let it go.

units.source_text: 这枝红梅果然可爱，那枝条的姿态、花房的模样，以及香气和颜色，都不是寻常的。

en.t: The red plum branch was indeed lovely; the shape of its branch, the form of its blossoms, and even its fragrance and color were all extraordinary.

units.source_text: 他说：“园中开着的红梅，都只是颜色艳丽而已，讲到香气，总不及白梅。

en.t: He said, "The red plums blooming in the garden are merely vivid in color; when it comes to fragrance, they never match the white plum.

units.source_text: 惟有这枝红梅开得特别好，真乃色香俱全。”

en.t: Only this red plum branch has bloomed especially well; it truly possesses both color and fragrance."

units.source_text: 此人本来喜爱梅花，如今投其所好，使他赞美不已。

en.t: He had always loved plum blossoms, and now that this matched his taste, it made him praise it without end.

units.source_text: 后来他对小公子说：“你今夜到宫中值宿，就住在我这里吧。”

en.t: Later he said to the young lord, "If you are on night duty in the palace tonight, stay here with me."

units.source_text: 就拉他到自己房内，把门关上。

en.t: Then he drew him into his own room and shut the door.

units.source_text: 小公子便不去参见皇太子。

en.t: The young lord therefore did not go to attend upon the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 匂皇子身上香气之馥郁，是花也比不上的。

en.t: The rich fragrance that clung to Prince Niou's person was beyond even flowers to rival.

units.source_text: 小公子睡在他身旁，童心欢喜无比，觉得此人真可亲爱。

en.t: Sleeping beside him, the young lord was filled with childish delight and felt that this man was truly lovable and kind.

units.source_text: 匂皇子问他：“这花的主人为什么不去侍奉皇太子？”

en.t: Prince Niou asked him, "Why does the owner of this flower not go to serve the Crown Prince?"

units.source_text: 小公子答道：“我不知道。

en.t: The young lord answered, "I do not know.

units.source_text: 听父亲说：要她去侍奉知心的人。”

en.t: I heard Father say that she should go to serve someone who understands her heart."

units.source_text: 匂皇子曾听人说：红梅大纳言想把自己所生的二女公子嫁给他。

en.t: Prince Niou had once heard that the Red Plum Grand Counselor wished to marry his own second daughter to him.

units.source_text: 而他所想望的却是萤兵部卿亲王所生的东厅女公子。

en.t: But the one he longed for was the young lady of the east wing, born to Prince Hotaru, Minister of War.

units.source_text: 但在答诗中不便直说。

en.t: Yet it would not do to say that plainly in his reply poem.

units.source_text: 次日小公子退出时，他就淡然地写了一首答诗，叫他带回去。

en.t: The next day, when the young lord was leaving, he casually wrote a reply poem and had him take it back.

units.source_text: 诗曰：

en.t: The poem read:
